summary: Copies string a2 into destination lpSrcStr via strcpy, passes the result through helper sub_589901, then returns -1 when sub_54A870(a3) returns nonzero and 0 otherwise. The ABI label 'Self_Copy_String_with_Validation' names the helper-based copy-and-validate pattern; the exact meaning of the a3 validation result is not known.

local_names.lpSrcStr: destination string buffer written by strcpy
local_names.a3: value passed to sub_54A870; its validation semantics are unknown

operations.description: strcpy copies the source string a2 into the destination buffer lpSrcStr.
The result of strcpy is passed to helper sub_589901, which is assumed to validate or otherwise process the completed copy.
sub_54A870(a3) is invoked and its return value decides the result of this function.
The negated comparison -(sub_54A870(a3) != 0) maps a nonzero helper result to -1 and a zero helper result to 0.
Returns -1 when sub_54A870(a3) is nonzero, otherwise 0.

unresolved: Meaning of sub_54A870's return value and what a3 represents; the 0 vs -1 result direction is uninterpreted.
Purpose of the sub_589901 wrapper around strcpy (validation, logging, or post-copy processing).
Which object/string context this helper belongs to.
